verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no export capability for customer, alert, case or decision data. What it does show is that the API can retrieve entities by token (alloy-tryit-20261106) and that External Entity IDs can be assigned (alloy-docs-24). Those are building blocks a developer could use to assemble an export, not a documented export or reconciliation feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation
